extracted.intended_audience: media/press, licensees, sponsors, donors, investigators, and members of the public seeking official MLB contact and procedural guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Official MLB page listing contact points, procedural requirements, and channels for press, licensing, sponsorship, donations, investigations, footage/photo licensing, and related inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Contact: MLB Communications, 1271 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY, 10020. Phone: 212-931-7878; Twitter: @MLB_PR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use MLB Communications as the primary contact for press-related inquiries (address, phone number, and social media handle provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Department of Investigations reporting channels
rubrics_metrics.description: To report potential misconduct, such as violations of MLB's conduct policies applicable to players and staff, contact MLB's Department of Investigations via direct phone or email. This is not a general customer service line.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct contact: 239-688-5850 or MLBDOI@mlb.com. Explicitly note: do not use this line for customer service; use the site's Contact Us page for customer service inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymous reporting (text and phone) for investigations
rubrics_metrics.description: Anonymous Reporting by Text and Phone is available for domestic and international reporters of misconduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anonymous text: Domestic 732-TXT-2DOI (732-898-2364); International 001-732-TXT-2DOI (001-732-898-2364). Anonymous phone: Domestic 888-RPT-2MLB (888-778-2652); International numbers include 888-980-3109 (Dominican Republic) and 866-769-8499 (Venezuela).

rubrics_metrics.name: Donation request procedure and lead time
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for support (donation requests) should be submitted through the Donation Request form on MLBTogether.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All requests should be sent at least 45 days in advance of the date of the event.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship and advertising inquiry channel
rubrics_metrics.description: For information about sponsorship/advertising opportunities, submit requests to Sponsorships and Affiliate Relations at Major League Baseball.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mailing address: 1271 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY, 10020. Phone: 212-485-3444. Email: mlbamsponsorship@mlb.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer product licensing and retail inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: For consumer product licensing information and retail opportunities for MLB licensed products, contact specified MLB licensing/retail email addresses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consumer product licensing email: Licensing_PublishingDepartment@mlb.com. Retail opportunities email: retail@mlb.com. Also: read the MLB Policy for Online Distribution and Marketing of MLBP-Licensed Products (link referenced).

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing editorial copy and photos from MLB.com
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a request for information about licensing editorial copy and photos seen on MLB.com, contact MLB.com Copy and Photo License Requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact via Major League Baseball, 1271 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY, 10020; Phone: 212-485-3444. (Provides the channel for licensing reuse of editorial copy/photos.)

rubrics_metrics.name: MLB footage licensing and ballpark shoot guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The MLB Library provides archival baseball footage and can advise on conducting ballpark shoots on gameday or non-gameday at any of the 30 MLB ballparks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a TV or film project requires original footage or a ballpark shoot, contact the Footage Licensing Department at MLBfootage@mlb.com. The page highlights available assets (game broadcasts, ballpark scenics, interviews, locker rooms, training facilities) and indicates the department will guide producers through necessary steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: MLB Photos official stock photo agency
rubrics_metrics.description: MLB Photos is the official stock photo agency for Major League Baseball, with inventory including contemporary and historical players, stadiums, and events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact mlbphotos@mlb.com for photo licensing and inquiries related to MLB Photos' inventory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Player agent contact channel
rubrics_metrics.description: For player agent information, contact the MLB Players Association directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phone: 212-826-0808. Use this channel for agent-related enquiries rather than MLB corporate press/licensing channels.
